note: Edits to the OSM layout for Langston, built into edited/course.geojson by pipeline/merge_edits.py (run by make course). The lidar tees are proposals from pipeline/propose_tees.py (run as: python3 propose_tees.py langston --wide=5,6,10; the ids depend on that command), added by the course chat on 2026-10-19 for the developer to confirm in the pull request; to drop one, delete its id here and rebuild.

tags.assigned_by: the course chat at the developer's request (lidar pad, edits.json)

add.reason: Hole 10 Royal (back) tee across Kingman Lake on the front-nine side, which the developer asked for (2026-10-19: 'a teebox on the other side of the lake from the driving range, same side as the front nine'). The lidar shows a raised levelled pad on the west bank of the lake channel; from it the hole measures 527 yd against 538 on the card (-2.1%). Tagged hole=10 tee_set=Royal because it is 95 m off the OSM hole line.

Tee boxes missing from OSM (OSM maps one tee per hole, mostly the White tees), found in the DC lidar DEM as raised levelled pads on the tee-shot axis and within 8% of the card for a tee set without a matching OSM box: lidar_tee_1: 3 Royal 508/508 (0.0%) | lidar_tee_12: 5 Royal and White 351/350 (+0.3%) | lidar_tee_56: 10 White 454/438 (+3.6%) | lidar_tee_70: 11 White 389/383 (+1.6%) | lidar_tee_72: 12 Royal 446/444 (+0.5%) | lidar_tee_77: 15 White 168/170 (-0.9%) | lidar_tee_81: 18 Royal 386/383 (+0.8%)

add.reason: Hole 17 Royal tee: a raised pad 79 m behind the OSM (White) tee on the line of play; 398 yd against 396 on the card (+0.5%). Without it the Royal 17 plays 346 yd (-12.6%). Tagged hole/tee_set because it is more than 40 m from the line start.

add.reason: Hole 13 White tee: the only forward pad on the island tip (157 m2, the Gold tee by distance: 140 yd vs 142). White plays it at 140 yd against 152 (-7.9%); the OSM tee (the Royal tee) would be 178 yd (+17%).

The creek across hole 3 (Wikipedia: 'a creek on the par-5 3rd') and on to Kingman Lake past the 17 tee is only an OSM stream line (w50095952, w902825870). The penalty areas follow the channel the lidar DEM shows along those lines (pipeline/propose_channels.py langston w50095952 w902825870: about 4 m wide, 0.3-0.5 m deep). Red, as the developer asked for every water hazard (2026-10-19). Tagged flatten=no: the bed falls about 4 m from the hole 3 end to the lake, so s04 keeps the lidar bed instead of flattening it like a pond.
